name: Recursive Cloning
hint: Scripts starting with [sbi]When I start as a clone[/sbi] should not create clones of itself. This could result in an infinite number of clones.
instruction: Delete the [sbi]create clone of [ v][/sbi] statement.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when i start as a clone
show
forever
change [color v] effect by (10)
create clone of (myself v) :: #ff0000 //⇦  🐛
end

examples.label: Possible Solution
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
hide
create clone of (myself v) :: #007000 //⇦  👍

when i start as a clone
show
forever
change [color v] effect by (10)
end
